BL-1863 — The operator adds or removes the local LLM from Telegram or Cursor - /localllm remove and /localllm add run local_llm.sh behind one Confirm tap and reply with its output, /localllm add force passes the GPU override, and a bare /localllm (or /localllm status) relays local_llm.sh status without a confirm
What it solves: ## Why
Approval context: The human asked for verbs that make adding and removing the local LLM easy (source); the intake let the specifier choose whether the pair is also an operator verb. RULED: yes, on the BL-698 surface, as /localllm (no hyphen, so it types easily on a phone). remove and add are soft (one Confirm tap, l…
